text:
Barehipani Falls is a two-tiered waterfall located in Simlipal National Park in Mayurbhanj district in the Indian state of Odisha. It is the second highest waterfalls in India.

--- Practical Travel Context (Wikivoyage) ---
Northwest Odisha covers the north-western region of Odisha. It includes the districts of Nuapada, Balangir, Bargarh, Baripada, Mayurbhanj, Kendujhar, Sundargarh, 
Jharsuguda, Sambalpur, Debagarh, Angul, Subarnapur and Dhenkanal
best_time: July to September (monsoon for lush greenery and roaring cascades) or October to March
